Each small function does one job and returns a new DataFrame; .pipe() chains them.

code:
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Clean the orders file.")
parser.add_argument("--input", type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()

clean = clean_orders(pd.read_csv(args.input))
clean.to_csv(args.output, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
caption: argparse avoids hard-coded paths; the __main__ guard means importing this never runs it.
